policy: Each of 23 original JPEG binaries obtained and SHA1 checked at download; independent SHA256 checks and all 23 image decodes passed in final combined research ZIP.
Original file bytes are quarantined research artifacts, not approved site media.
No new user decision or rights clearance. All 20 prior KEEP preview decisions preserved.
B15's generic Commons free-text fallback caused 12 false-positive original-file acquisitions; source-verified exact-file seeds must be required for any subsequent binary acquisition.
An unidentified file is not an appropriate object hero merely because dimensions and a CC/PD declaration pass.
The two identity-uncertain files require exact object/source proof, not arbitrary reassignment.
Visual review conducted on genuine decoded originals and EXIF-corrected preview contact sheet; visual impression cannot alone verify provenance or rights.
